newsitem.title: FRANCE: Landmine kills 10-year-old boy in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Landmine kills 10-year-old boy in Algeria.

text.p: A landmine killed a 10-year-old boy and wounded his eight-year-old sister in Algeria, the official Algerian news agency APS reported on Tuesday.

The two children unearthed the mine, planted by former French colonial soldiers, and started playing with it in el Foulia village in el Oued southeastern province, 500 km (300 miles) from Algiers, added APS. It said the incident occurred in the past few days.
Algerians fought a war of independence against France between 1954 and 1962.
